Top 15 Bull names by bias with an explode score of 60 or more. Act-on rule (fixed, not tuned on results): both legs bid, each leg's spread under 50% of mid or $0.10 wide, open interest at least the order size, still Bull; up to 5 by bias (ties: higher P(profit)), $2,000 each. P(profit) and P(max) are the options market's own odds, so each spread's expected payoff is roughly its cost. Each is priced to finish with some profit at least half the time, but the loss when wrong (the whole debit) is bigger than the gain when right. Delayed quotes: re-check prices before entering. This is a screen, not advice. Orders are entered by hand.
